evidence: In a typical PE-ALD process carried out at a relatively low temperature (120 /C14 C), the oxygen source and Ga precursor were provided by oxygen plasma and triethylgallium (TEG), respectively. The ALD sequence for atomic-layer Ti incorporation in Ga 2O3 thin films involved pulsing and purging of both titanium tetraisopropoxide (TTIP) and H2O.
